description: Applies a boolean function to up to four inputs across sixteen polyphonic channels, with the function selectable by CV and a sample and hold on the result.

params.text: Steps to the next boolean function, in the order AND, NOR, XOR, OR and NAND.

inputs.text: A trigger makes the module hold its result until the next trigger; with nothing patched the output follows the inputs continuously. Polyphonic and normalled to its first channel.
Selects the boolean function: a trigger steps to the next one, or 0-10V in five steps of 2V, or notes C4 to E4, as set on the menu. Monophonic.
One of the four signals the boolean function is applied to; read as high from 1.0V and low below it. Polyphonic, with only connected channels counted.

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the boolean function is true and 0V while it is false, or a 1ms trigger when it turns true or on any change of the result, as set on the menu.

menu: Port OP mode — 0..10V, C4-E4 or Trigger, setting how the OP port picks the boolean function.
Output mode — Gate, Trigger on high, or Trigger on change.
